summary.text: Joe Bellino is a Republican state senator from Michigan State Senate District 16 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 17 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023 and is a small-business owner.

paragraphs.text: Joe Bellino, listed by Ballotpedia as Joseph Bellino, graduated from Monroe Catholic Central High School.
His career experience includes owning and operating Broadway Market.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he owned a small business for several decades and served on the Monroe County Community College board.
Bellino served in the Michigan House from 2017 to 2023, chairing the House Energy Committee in 2019 through 2022.

In the Senate, his 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Energy and Environment, Transportation and Infrastructure, and Regulatory Reform committees, and he is minority vice chair of the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.
In the 2022 survey, he listed parental control in education, school choice and economic development among his key messages.
